title: Agriculture
summary: Robust pressed, formed and welded components for agricultural machinery and implements.
intro: Agricultural equipment components have a different failure profile to automotive parts: less about micron tolerances, more about surviving shock loads, abrasion and weather over long service intervals in the field.
body: That means heavier gauges, larger formed parts and welded assemblies that hold up under load — work suited to our 150-tonne and 250-tonne press capacity and our 25 mm HR steel cutting range.
Typical components include mounting brackets and hitch components, guards and shields, formed structural parts, and welded frame sub-assemblies.

This is a target sector for us. The relevant capability — heavy pressing, structural cutting, fixture welding, coated finishes through partners — is already in place and proven on automotive structural work.
